question: When must an individual file the annual income tax return?
publicApiAnswer:
### Short Answer

### Interpretation

### Practical Meaning
In practical terms, individuals should prepare their income tax returns in advance of the April 15 deadline to avoid penalties for late filing. It is advisable to maintain accurate records of all income and deductions throughout the year to facilitate the timely and accurate completion of the return. Failure to file by the deadline may result in penalties and interest on any unpaid taxes.
